title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
清明时节，烟雨纷纷。
西湖苏堤上走来两个清秀的女子。她们一个身着白袍素衣，柔美端庄；一个穿着青衣绿裙，俏皮可爱。
白衣女子叫白娘子，本名白素贞，原是峨眉山修炼千年的白蛇，而她身旁的小青，是一条青蛇。
如今，她们都变幻成人的模样。
page_text_en:
It was the Qingming Festival, with drizzling rain falling gently.
On the Su Causeway of West Lake, two graceful women walked along. One wore a white robe, elegant and dignified; the other wore a blue dress with green skirt, lively and charming.
The woman in white was called Bai Niangzi, whose real name was Bai Suzhen. She was a white snake who had cultivated for a thousand years on Mount Emei. Beside her was Xiao Qing, a green snake.
Now, they had both transformed into human form.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了清明时节，白素贞与小青在西湖苏堤上行走的场景，并介绍了她们的来历：白素贞是修炼千年的白蛇，小青是青蛇，如今都化为人形。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
清明这天，许仙外出祭祖。走到西湖边，突然下起了大雨，许仙赶忙唤来一条小船。
杭州城里有一位书生，名叫许仙，温文尔雅、清俊秀气，在一家药铺当学徒。
page_text_en:
On the day of Qingming, Xu Xian went out to pay respects to his ancestors. As he walked to the edge of West Lake, it suddenly started pouring rain. Xu Xian hurriedly called for a small boat.
In Hangzhou, there was a scholar named Xu Xian, gentle and refined, handsome and elegant, working as an apprentice in a pharmacy.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了书生许仙的背景，并描绘了清明时节他在西湖边遇雨，急忙唤来小船的场景。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh: 许仙躲进船舱，刚坐下，便看见对面坐着两位女子。许仙愣住了，小青忍不住扑哧一笑。许仙赶紧低头，心怦怦直跳，脸羞得通红。小船摇摇晃晃，在湖面上荡开层层波纹。
page_text_en: Xu Xian hurried into the boat cabin. As soon as he sat down, he saw two women sitting opposite him. Xu Xian was stunned, and Xiao Qing couldn't help but let out a soft laugh. Xu Xian quickly lowered his head, his heart pounding, his face flushed red. The small boat swayed gently, creating ripples on the lake's surface.
summary_zh: 许仙在雨中乘船，与白素贞和小青同船，因见到两位女子而羞涩不已，小青忍不住发笑，小船在湖面上摇晃前行。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
将上岸时，小青对许仙说：“这位公子，我和小姐没带雨伞，可否借你的一用？”
“小青，这位公子只有一把伞啊！”
白娘子话音刚落，许仙就双手把伞递过来：“尽管、尽管拿去吧。”
“多谢，改天你来我们白府取吧。”小青俏皮地笑道。
page_text_en:
As they were about to reach the shore, Xiao Qing said to Xu Xian, "Sir, my sister and I didn't bring an umbrella. Could we borrow yours for a moment?"
"Xiao Qing, this gentleman only has one umbrella!"
As Bai Niangzi finished speaking, Xu Xian immediately handed over the umbrella with both hands: "Please, take it. Go ahead and take it."
"Thank you. Come to our Bai residence another day to pick it up," Xiao Qing said playfully.
summary_zh: 小青向许仙借伞，白娘子提醒许仙只有一把伞，许仙慷慨地将伞借给她们，小青俏皮地承诺改日归还。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh: 许仙不顾瓢泼大雨，跑走了。白娘子看出许仙是个老实淳厚的人，对他心生好感。
page_text_en: Xu Xian ran away without caring about the pouring rain. Bai Niangzi noticed that Xu Xian was a sincere and kind-hearted person, and she developed a good feeling for him.
summary_zh: 许仙在大雨中跑开，白娘子看出他老实淳厚，对他心生好感。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
一个风和日丽的日子，许仙来到白府。
只见白府典雅古朴，像个大户人家。许仙
当然不知道这其实是白娘子施展法
术变出来的。
page_text_en:
On a sunny and pleasant day, Xu Xian arrived at Bai's residence.
He saw that Bai's residence was elegant and simple, like a wealthy household. Xu Xian
of course didn't know that this was actually transformed by Bai Niangzi using magic.
summary_zh: 许仙在风和日丽的一天来到白府，只见府邸典雅古朴，但他并不知道这是白娘子用法术变出来的。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
白娘子设宴款待许仙。看到白娘子
妩媚温柔，许仙不免动心。
page_text_en:
Bai Niangzi set a feast to entertain Xu Xian. Seeing Bai Niangzi
graceful and gentle, Xu Xian couldn't help but be moved.
summary_zh: 白娘子设宴款待许仙，许仙被她的妩媚温柔所打动，心生好感。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
席间，许仙说道：“我父母离世早，一直寄住在姐姐家里，希望早日学成医术，济世救民。”
“同是天涯沦落人，想不到，你和我姐姐是一样的遭遇。”小青说道。
“这从何说起？”
“我父母去世得早，独留这大宅子。我虽然衣食无忧，但也盼望今后能够为父老乡亲做一些事情。”白娘子说道。
page_text_en:
At the banquet, Xu Xian said, "My parents passed away early. I've been living with my elder sister, hoping to master medicine soon and help others." 
"We are both wanderers in this world. I never thought you and my sister have had the same fate," said Xiao Qing. 
"What do you mean?" 
"My parents died young, leaving me this big house. Though I have no worries about food and clothing, I also hope to do something for my fellow villagers in the future," said Bai Niangzi.
summary_zh: 在宴席上，许仙向白娘子和小青讲述自己父母早逝、寄居姐姐家并立志学医的经历，白娘子和小青听后感同身受，表达了对彼此相似遭遇的共鸣。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
那天，白娘子和许仙聊了很久。
他们情投意合、惺惺相惜，
感叹相见恨晚。
page_text_en:
That day, Bai Niangzi and Xu Xian talked for a long time.
They were in perfect harmony, deeply understanding each other,
and sighed at how late they had met.
summary_zh: 白娘子与许仙在白府中交谈甚久，彼此情投意合，惺惺相惜，感叹相见恨晚。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh: 许仙回家后，把遇到白娘子的事告诉了姐姐，姐姐正为他的终身大事发愁呢。见过知书达理、谈吐不凡的白娘子之后，姐姐非常满意。于是，没过多久，许仙和白娘子便结为夫妻。
page_text_en: After returning home, Xu Xian told his sister about meeting Lady Bai. His sister had been worried about his future marriage. After meeting the well-educated and eloquent Lady Bai, she was very pleased. Soon after, Xu Xian and Lady Bai became husband and wife.
summary_zh: 许仙将遇见白娘子的事告诉姐姐，姐姐十分满意，不久后两人便结为夫妻。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
他们拜别姐姐，来到江苏镇江。
在白娘子的帮助下，许仙在当地开了一家药铺，取名
“保和堂”。许仙善良勤恳、乐善好施，白娘子法术高明、
暗中助力。每天，来保和堂求医问诊的人络绎不绝，
白娘子和许仙还经常帮那些穷苦的百姓，免费给他们治病。
page_text_en:
They bid farewell to their sister and arrived in Zhenjiang, Jiangsu.
With the help of Bai Niangzi, Xu Xian opened a pharmacy locally, named
"Bao He Tang". Xu Xian was kind, diligent, and generous; Bai Niangzi, with her powerful magic, secretly assisted him. Every day, people came to Bao He Tang in large numbers to seek medical help, and Bai Niangzi and Xu Xian often helped poor villagers by treating them for free.
summary_zh: 许仙与白娘子在镇江开了一家名为“保和堂”的药铺，许仙善良勤恳，白娘子暗中用法术相助，两人常免费为穷苦百姓治病，药铺生意兴隆。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
保和堂受到了乡亲父老的盛赞，声名鹊起。
没过多久，白娘子怀孕了，无限的温暖与幸福在这个家庭蔓延。
金山寺有个法号“法海”的和尚。一天，他路过保和堂，觉得这里妖气很重，便走了进去，立刻认出白娘子是修炼千年的蛇妖。
在法海看来，蛇妖下凡，一定会祸害人间。
page_text_en:
The Baohe Hall received high praise from the local elders and gained a great reputation.
Not long after, Lady Bai became pregnant, and endless warmth and happiness spread throughout the family.
There was a monk at Jinshan Temple with the Dharma name 'Fahai'. One day, as he passed by Baohe Hall, he felt a heavy aura of evil and went inside. He immediately recognized Lady Bai as a snake spirit who had cultivated for a thousand years.
In Fahai's eyes, a snake spirit descending to the mortal world would surely bring disaster to humanity.
summary_zh: 保和堂因善行声名远播，白娘子怀孕后家庭幸福美满，但金山寺的法海和尚路过时察觉妖气，认定白娘子是修炼千年的蛇妖，认为她会祸害人间。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
法海将白娘子是蛇精的事告诉了许仙，希望他能离开白娘子。
许仙并不相信，他说：“我娘子善良慈悲、花容月貌，方圆百里的
人都知道她医术高明，怎么可能是妖怪？”
“问题就在这里，许施主，如果她真是你我一样的凡人，怎么合
什么病都能治呢？”法海问道。
“这……这……”被法海这样一问，许仙也起了疑心。
page_text_en:
Fahai told Xu Xian that Bai Niangzi was a snake spirit and hoped he would leave her.
Xu Xian didn't believe it. He said, "My wife is kind-hearted, beautiful, and everyone within a hundred miles knows her medical skills are excellent. How could she possibly be a monster?"
"That's exactly the problem, Master Xu. If she were truly an ordinary mortal like you and me, how could she cure any illness?" Fahai asked.
"This... this..." After being questioned like that, Xu Xian began to have doubts.
summary_zh: 法海向许仙揭露白娘子是蛇精，许仙起初不信，但在法海质疑其医术的合理性后，开始心生疑虑。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
此后，他暗自观察白娘子，并没有发现什么不寻常的地方，也就没有再把法海的话放在心上。快到端午节的时候，法海又来了，他问许仙："许施主，你还未离开那个蛇精吗？"
"你不要再满嘴胡言！"法海拍了拍许仙的肩膀："你若将驱恶避邪的雄黄放入酒里，让那蛇精喝下，它必会现出原形，你若不信，不妨一试。"
page_text_en:
Afterward, he secretly observed Lady Bai and found nothing unusual, so he no longer took Master Fa Hai's words to heart. As the Dragon Boat Festival approached, Fa Hai came again and asked Xu Xian: "Master Xu, haven't you left that snake spirit yet?"
"Don't keep talking nonsense!" Fa Hai patted Xu Xian's shoulder: "If you put the evil-repelling realgar into wine and make that snake spirit drink it, it will surely reveal its true form. If you don't believe me, why not try it?"
summary_zh: 法海再次来到许仙的药铺，劝说他相信白娘子是蛇精，并建议他用雄黄酒让白娘子现出原形，许仙对此表示怀疑。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
小青因法力尚浅，怕在端午节那天现出原形，就提前躲进了深山。临行前，她再三叮嘱姐姐要小心。
千年道行的白娘子选择留在家里，和许仙共度佳节。
谁料节日那天，许仙不仅在门内插满菖蒲、艾草，还在酒里加入了雄黄。白娘子并不知情，喝下了雄黄酒。
page_text_en:
Xiaoqing, whose magical powers were still weak, feared revealing her true form on the Dragon Boat Festival, so she hid in the mountains beforehand. Before leaving, she repeatedly warned her sister to be careful.
Bai Niangzi, with a thousand years of cultivation, chose to stay at home and celebrate the festival with Xu Xian.
Unbeknownst to Bai Niangzi, on the festival day, Xu Xian not only filled the doorways with calamus and mugwort, but also added realgar to the wine. Bai Niangzi, unaware of this, drank the realgar wine.
summary_zh: 小青因法力不足提前躲进深山避端午，白娘子留在家中与许仙共度佳节。许仙在门内插菖蒲艾草，并在酒中加入雄黄，白娘子不知情饮下雄黄酒。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
顷刻间，白娘子真身显露，一条硕大的白蛇出现在许仙的眼前，许仙吓得一头栽在地上，昏死过去。
过了一会儿，酒力减弱，白娘子又恢复了人形，清醒过来。见许仙被自己吓晕，只有一息尚存，白娘子非常内疚。
page_text_en:
In an instant, Bai Niangzi's true form appeared — a huge white snake stood before Xu Xian, who was so frightened that he fell to the ground and fainted.
After a while, the alcohol's effect weakened, and Bai Niangzi regained her human form and consciousness. Seeing Xu Xian, whom she had frightened into unconsciousness, still barely alive, Bai Niangzi felt deeply guilty.
summary_zh: 白娘子饮下雄黄酒后现出原形，吓晕了许仙；酒力退去后她恢复人形，见许仙昏迷不醒，内心十分愧疚。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh: 她对赶到家里的小青说：“我要去昆仑山盗取灵芝仙草，救官人。”
page_text_en: She told Xiaoqing, who had rushed home, "I must go to Kunlun Mountain to steal the magical lingzhi herb and save my husband."
summary_zh: 白娘子告诉赶回家的小青，她要前往昆仑山盗取灵芝仙草，以救治昏迷的许仙。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh: “都怪法海那个老秃驴，也怪许官人这么轻信别人的话。姐姐，这一路艰险，你可要小心。”
page_text_en: "It's all because of that old monk Fahai, and also because Master Xu is so gullible. Sister, this journey is dangerous, you must be careful."
summary_zh: 小青对白娘子说，法海和许仙都应为当前困境负责，并叮嘱白娘子前往昆仑山盗取灵芝仙草的路上要小心。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
告别了小青，白娘子转身飞往昆仑山。
费尽千辛万苦，冲破重重阻挠，白娘子
终于取回了灵芝仙草。
许仙服下灵芝仙草后转危为安，
身体日渐好转。
page_text_en:
Farewell to Xiao Qing, Bai Niangzi flew toward Kunlun Mountain.
After enduring countless hardships and overcoming重重 obstacles, Bai Niangzi
finally retrieved the magical Lingzhi herb.
After taking the Lingzhi herb, Xu Xian turned from danger to safety,
and his body gradually improved.
summary_zh: 白娘子告别小青，历经艰险飞往昆仑山盗取灵芝仙草，最终成功带回，许仙服下后身体日渐好转。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
可此时的法海依然不肯罢休，他诱骗
许仙来到金山寺，并把他软禁起来，
想设法收服白娘子。
白娘子一路辛苦寻找许仙，终于到达了
金山寺。
page_text_en:
But at this time, Fahai still refused to give up. He tricked
Xu Xian to the Jinshan Temple and imprisoned him,
intending to subdue Bai Niangzi.
Bai Niangzi, after a long and arduous search for Xu Xian, finally arrived at
Jinshan Temple.
summary_zh: 法海诱骗许仙至金山寺并将其软禁，白娘子历经辛苦终于抵达金山寺寻找许仙。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
白娘子向法海苦苦哀求：“求您放了我家官人！
法海冷笑道：“大胆妖孽，敢来人间作怪！你若有回去继续修炼，
兴许我还能放你一马，否则，休怪老衲无情。”
“我从未害过一草一木，念在我曾救济一方
百姓的分儿上，请您放了我家官人。”
“姐姐，不要和这个老秃驴理论了。”小青冲到了法海跟前，与
法海展开较量。
page_text_en:
Bai Niangzi pleaded desperately with Fa Hai: "Please let my husband go!"
Fa Hai sneered coldly: "You bold demon, daring to cause trouble in the human world! If you return to continue your cultivation, perhaps I can let you go unharmed. Otherwise, don't blame me for being merciless."
"I have never harmed a single blade of grass or tree. Considering that I once helped the common people, please let my husband go."
"Sister, don't argue with this old monk!" Xiao Qing rushed to Fa Hai's side and engaged him in combat.
summary_zh: 白娘子在金山寺向法海求情，请求释放许仙，法海拒绝并嘲讽她为妖孽，小青愤而与法海展开对峙。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
小青哪里是法海的对手，没几个回合便身负重伤，难以招架。白娘子还在一边乞求：“求您放了我的相公，放了我们吧。”
此时的法海已经完全失去理智，他甩起禅杖不断挥打小青，眼看小青就要一命呜呼了。
page_text_en:
Xiaoqing is no match for Fahai; after just a few rounds, she is severely injured and unable to defend herself. Bai Niangzi pleads from the side: "Please spare my husband, spare us!"
At this moment, Fahai has completely lost his reason; he swings his staff repeatedly at Xiaoqing, and it seems Xiaoqing is about to lose her life.
summary_zh: 小青与法海对峙时身负重伤，白娘子在一旁苦苦哀求法海放过许仙，法海却失去理智，欲用禅杖打死小青。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
白娘子扶稳小青，从盘发上取下一枚金钗，
迎风一摇，瞬间，天昏地暗，狂风不止，
长江回流，巨浪滔天。浩荡的江水、
虾兵蟹将一齐朝金山寺涌去。
page_text_en:
Bai Niangzi steadied Xiao Qing, took a golden hairpin from her coiled hair,
swung it into the wind, and instantly, the sky darkened, the wind raged,
the Yangtze River reversed its flow, and giant waves surged. The vast river water,
along with shrimp soldiers and crab generals, rushed toward Jinshan Temple together.
summary_zh: 白娘子为救许仙，取下金钗迎风一摇，引发天昏地暗、巨浪滔天，率领虾兵蟹将向金山寺涌去。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
法海这下慌了，立即将身上的袈裟变成一道长堤，挡住了滔滔江水。
白娘子加大法力，掀起惊涛骇浪，江水不断上涨，谁料长堤也跟着加高，江水怎样也漫不进去。
白娘子没有胜算，加上有孕在身，无奈收手。
水漫金山时，许仙趁机从金山寺逃了出来，偷偷跑回了杭州。
page_text_en:
Fahai panicked and immediately turned his robe into a long dike, blocking the surging river water.
Bai Niangzi increased her magical power, raising huge waves, and the river water kept rising. But to her surprise, the dike also rose higher, preventing the water from flooding through.
Bai Niangzi had no chance of winning, and with her pregnancy, she had no choice but to give up.
During the flood of Jinshan, Xu Xian took the opportunity to escape from Jinshan Temple and secretly ran back to Hangzhou.
summary_zh: 白娘子与法海在金山寺外展开水战，法海以袈裟化作长堤阻挡洪水，白娘子因有孕在身无法取胜而收手；与此同时，许仙趁乱从金山寺逃出，返回杭州。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
断桥边已是残荷败柳，满目凄凉。
白娘子与许仙重逢了。小青看到许仙，气不打一处来，抽出宝剑就向许仙挥去。白娘子赶紧挡下，恳求小青放过许仙，涕泪涟涟地对许仙说：“官人啊，你轻信谣言！你轻信谣言，害了我和小青，遭受牵连的还有镇江城那些无辜的百姓，更可怜的是我腹中的胎儿，他一出生就要背负这些罪孽！”
许仙脸色煞白，连忙伏在地上认错。
page_text_en:
By the Broken Bridge, withered lotus and withered willows, everything looked bleak.
White Snake and Xu Xian met again. Xiao Qing, seeing Xu Xian, was furious and drew her sword to strike him. White Snake quickly stepped in to block, pleading with Xiao Qing to spare Xu Xian. She wept bitterly to Xu Xian: "Husband, you believed the rumors! You believed the rumors, and harmed me and Xiao Qing. The innocent people of Zhenjiang were also dragged into this. Even more pitiful is the unborn child in my womb—he will be born carrying these sins!"
Xu Xian turned pale and hurriedly knelt on the ground to apologize.
summary_zh: 白娘子与许仙在断桥边重逢，小青因愤怒欲杀许仙，白娘子挡下并恳求许仙原谅，许仙则伏地认错。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
几天后，白娘子生下
儿子许仕林。
法海趁着白娘子的身体尚未恢复，冲入许家，想用手上的金钵将白娘子收服。
page_text_en:
A few days later, Bai Niangzi gave birth to her son, Xu Shilin.
Fahai, taking advantage of Bai Niangzi's weakened state, rushed into the Xu household, intending to capture her with the golden bowl in his hand.
summary_zh: 白娘子生下儿子许仕林后身体尚未恢复，法海趁机闯入许家，企图用金钵收服她。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
白娘子抱起尚未满月的孩子，轻抚他的小脸，亲亲他的额头，哭着说道："仕林，娘不能再陪伴你了。哪怕有一丝希望，娘也会留下，可是，那法海容不下娘啊。"
白娘子的泪水滴落在许仕林脸上，许仕林哭得更厉害了。
page_text_en:
Bai Niangzi picked up her newborn child, gently caressed his little face, kissed his forehead, and cried, saying, "Shilin, Mother can no longer stay with you. Even if there's a single thread of hope, Mother would stay, but that Fahai won't allow it."
Bai Niangzi's tears fell onto Xu Shilin's face, and Xu Shilin cried even harder.
summary_zh: 白娘子抱着刚满月的儿子许仕林，含泪告诉他因法海不容而无法陪伴，泪水滴落孩子脸上，许仕林哭得更厉害了。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
许仙苦苦哀求，却也奈何不了法海。“我娘子虽是妖怪，却从不害人。都是你害得我们妻离子散！”
法海漠然地念着“阿弥陀佛”，随后把白娘子收入金钵。
page_text_en:
Xu Xian pleaded desperately, but could not move Fa Hai. "My wife may be a demon, but she has never harmed anyone. It's all your fault that we've been torn apart!"
Fa Hai coldly chanted "Amitabha," and then imprisoned Bai Niangzi in the golden bowl.
summary_zh: 法海不顾许仙的苦苦哀求，念动咒语将白娘子收入金钵中，许仙在屋檐下绝望地望着，一只猫在瓦片上奔跑。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
白娘子被法海镇压在西子湖畔的雷峰塔下。

小青躲进深山，日夜修炼，盼望早日得道，救出姐姐。
page_text_en:
Bai Niangzi was suppressed by Fahai beneath the Leifeng Pagoda by the shores of West Lake.

Xiao Qing retreated into the deep mountains, practicing day and night, hoping to attain enlightenment soon and rescue her sister.
summary_zh: 白娘子被法海镇压在雷峰塔下，小青则躲入深山日夜修炼，期盼早日得道救出姐姐。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
转眼二十年过去了，许仕林不负众望，高中状元。得知自己的身世后，他三次祭塔，想要救出母亲，孝心感天动地。
天上的仙人也来帮助小青和仕林，将法海打败了。
雷峰塔轰然倒塌，法海仓皇出逃。
page_text_en:
Twenty years passed, and Xu Shilin lived up to expectations, becoming a top scholar. After learning of his true identity, he visited the tower three times, hoping to rescue his mother, his filial piety touching the heavens.
The immortals from above also came to help Xiao Qing and Shilin, defeating Fahai.
The Leifeng Tower collapsed with a thunderous crash, and Fahai fled in panic.
summary_zh: 二十年后，许仕林高中状元，得知身世后三次祭塔救母，感动天地。仙人相助，法海被打败，雷峰塔倒塌，法海仓皇逃窜。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
page_text_ocr_zh:
被关押二十年的白娘子
终于重见天日。
一家人幸福团圆，从此
天伦共享。
page_text_en:
The White Snake, imprisoned for twenty years,
finally sees the light of day again.
The family is happily reunited, and from now on,
they enjoy their family life together.
summary_zh: 白娘子被关押二十年后终于重见天日，与家人团聚，共享天伦之乐。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
summary_zh: 画面描绘了雨中的断桥景象，桥上两人并肩而行，远处有船只和山岛，天空飘着细雨，水面泛起涟漪，整体氛围宁静而略带忧伤。

title_en: The Legend of the White Snake
summary_zh: 画面描绘了一条蓝黄相间的蛇盘绕成圈，圈内有一只粉色小兔子，背景为浅蓝色天空与水面，水面上有雨滴涟漪，右上角有柳枝垂下，整体氛围宁静而略带神秘。
